Our client seeks a Head of Insurance to join their team. Role Profile This is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing all aspects of supervision and maintenance/development of the regulatory framework applicable to the Islands insurance sector.You will contribute to the mandate by leading the effective and efficient prudential and conduct supervision of the islands insurance sector, which includes life insurers and life insurance groups, general insurers, captive insurers, insurance intermediaries and regulated insurance managers. This includes ensuring that robust supervisory controls, processes and engagement are in place, that supervisory activity is risk-based and proportionate, and that the insurance supervisory plan is delivered in a prioritised manner alongside demand-led matters and cross-Authority priorities.The role provides strategic leadership to the Prudential Supervision Division (alongside the Head of Banking), leads the Insurance Supervision and Policy teams, contributes to the development and maintenance of the Islands insurance regulatory framework in line with relevant legislation, regulatory requirements and international standards, and supports the Executive Team in strategy setting, risk horizon scanning and positive cultural leadership. You will be expected to demonstrate flexibility in the performance of their duties and responsibilities. From time to time, the Authority may require the postholder to undertake additional duties, projects, or responsibilities that are commensurate with the level of the role. This may include providing support or cover for other teams, functions or areas of the Authority to ensure business objectives and operational requirements are met. Manx Registered Charity 939
Are you interested in using your skills and experience in helping us to deliver our vision of “Eradicating loneliness - one friend at a time.”? 
We aim to reduce the loneliness experienced by older people and raise awareness of the impact which this can have on their quality of life.
Your principal responsibilities will be managing the day-to-day affairs of the charity, supervising and supporting colleagues and volunteers, liaising with the Board, raising the profile of the charity and working with the Board to secure the charity's long-term future.
You should understand the needs of older people, have excellent written, spoken and digital communication skills and be able to work without close supervision. This is a part-time role of twenty hours per week. You will usually be able to select the days and times which you work.  
If you require further information, including the Job Description, please contact the Board by emailing tina@southernbefrienders.im.
Please submit a letter of application and a CV to the Board via tina@southernbefrienders.im

Notes
Our client seeks a FATCA/CRS Analyst to join their team on a Temporary 6-Month Contract. Our client is a highly respected financial services group with an impressive international reach, operating across investment management, digital banking and open-architecture investment platform services. With a strong track record of serving financial intermediaries, corporate clients, trustees and high-net-worth individuals across the globe, this is an organisation built on trusted relationships, technical excellence and a genuine commitment to client-first values. You will be responsible for undertaking retrospective reviews of client records to ensure compliance with the Common Reporting Standard (CRS) and Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) regulations. The role focuses on validating the accuracy, completeness, and reasonableness of client self-certifications in accordance with CRS due diligence requirements, including enhanced requirements introduced under CRS 2.0.  The successful candidate will conduct detailed reviews of customer documentation, identify remediation requirements, engage with internal stakeholders, and support regulatory reporting obligations by ensuring tax residency information maintained by the Bank is accurate and current. Key Skills and Experience: Experience working within Banking or Financial Services. Working knowledge of FATCA and CRS regulations. Experience reviewing client due diligence and KYC documentation. Understanding of tax residency concepts and regulatory reporting requirements. Experience conducting customer remediation or retrospective review activities.
 For a full list of responsibilities and requirements or to apply for this great role, please visit the website at searchandselect.com, quoting the reference number:  16768

Notes
Mencap Isle of Man has been at the heart of the Island’s learning disability community for decades - creating opportunities, championing inclusion and helping people live more connected, independent and fulfilling lives.

At the heart of their work is a vibrant and welcoming community - bringing people together, building confidence and connections, and creating opportunities to participate, belong and thrive.  From activities and family support to advocacy and shaping better services, their work has a real and lasting impact across the Island.

Joining Mencap means becoming part of a small, committed team with a big sense of purpose, where your ideas, energy and contribution really matter.

Create opportunities. Build connections. Make a difference.  This is a rewarding, people-focused role creating and coordinating activities and experiences for adults with learning disabilities across the Island.

You’ll work closely with individuals, families, carers and community partners to develop accessible and engaging activities, bring events to life and create opportunities for people to connect, try something new and participate more fully in their community.

We’re looking for someone who brings:
Experience working with people with learning disabilities or within community engagement.  
Great communication skills and a natural ability to build relationships.  
Strong organisation, initiative and the confidence to work independently.  
 The ability to coordinate activities and keep multiple moving parts on track.  
Confidence using Microsoft Office and online communication platforms.  
A genuine commitment to inclusion, choice and independence.
  
Experience in events or project coordination, social media and content creation, safeguarding or measuring outcomes would be an advantage.  Some evening and weekend flexibility will be required and the successful applicant will be subject to an Enhanced DBS check.

If you’re someone who brings people together, turns ideas into opportunities and wants to see the difference your work makes, this could be the role for you.

Find out more here - https://www.paragon.co.im/careers/32634/index1/Adult-Activity-Coordinator-Permanent-Job-Isle-Man-Permanent-Isle-Man-Pp22841

We are delighted to be working with an established specialist investment management firm who are seeking an experienced Compliance Officer / MLRO to join their team on a part-time basis, approximately 2.5 days per week. This is an excellent opportunity for a compliance professional with investment management experience to take responsibility for a key regulatory function within an established business. The successful candidate will be responsible for the Isle of Man compliance function, ensuring the business continues to meet its regulatory obligations. The firm is regulated by the Isle of Man Financial Services Authority (IOMFSA) as an Investment Manager and also operates within a US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) regulated environment. The role will focus primarily on Isle of Man regulatory requirements, with external specialist support already in place for US SEC compliance matters. Previous SEC experience would be beneficial but is not essential. Key Responsibilities: Act as Compliance Officer and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) for Isle of Man regulated activities. Maintain and oversee the compliance framework in line with IOMFSA requirements. Provide compliance advice and guidance to the business. Review, update and maintain compliance policies, procedures and controls. Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of relevant changes. Oversee AML/CFT obligations and ensure appropriate controls remain in place. Support regulatory reporting and compliance monitoring activities. Work alongside external advisers supporting US SEC compliance requirements. Key Skills and Experience: Previous experience within investment management compliance. Experience working within a regulated financial services environment. Experience acting as a Compliance Officer and/or MLRO. Strong understanding of AML/CFT requirements and regulatory frameworks. The ability to work independently and manage a broad compliance remit. Strong communication skills with the confidence to work with senior stakeholders. Experience within asset management, hedge funds or investment firms would be highly desirable.

Notes
Self-Employed Sales Agent – Automotive Lubricants - Part time

We are looking for a friendly, professional and motivated self-employed sales agent to promote and sell Forté lubricants—an established, market-leading range of vehicle additives and workshop consumables—to customers throughout the automotive aftermarket, including workshops, dealerships and retail outlets across the Isle of Man.

This flexible, part-time opportunity would be ideal for someone who already represents a complementary, non-competing brand or works in a similar sales role. You will manage your own time and diary, making it easy to fit the role around your existing commitments. For the right person, there is potential to develop this into a full-time opportunity.

You will be part of a friendly, relaxed and supportive working environment while retaining the independence to develop your own customer relationships and sales territory.

What we offer:
A generous 20% commission rate. 
Uncapped earning potential. 
Realistically achievable bonus structure. 
Flexible, part-time hours. 
Freedom to manage your own diary and workload. 
The opportunity to develop the role into a full-time business. 
A friendly, relaxed and supportive working relationship. 
An established range of quality products. 

About you:
Friendly, confident and comfortable speaking with customers. 
Self-motivated, reliable and well organised. 
Smart and professional in appearance. 
Contactable during normal office hours. 
Able to work independently and manage your own appointments. 
Previous sales experience would be beneficial, particularly within the automotive, workshop, motor trade or a related sector. 
An existing network of relevant customers or a complementary agency would be an advantage. 

Essential requirements:
A full, valid driving licence. 
Your own suitable transport. 
Secure and appropriate storage space for holding stock. 
The ability to operate on a self-employed basis. 

This is a self-employed, commission-based opportunity and does not include a guaranteed salary. Your earnings will be based on your sales, with no upper limit on what you can earn.

If you are enthusiastic, professional and interested in developing a flexible sales opportunity around your existing commitments, we would be pleased to hear from you.
To apply for this role please call 	07858634837

Our client seeks a Senior Administrator to join their team. Role Profile The main purpose of this role is to manage and service a portfolio of Companies and Trusts. Key Responsibilities: Manage the needs and expectations of your clients, prioritising tasks that are considered urgent. Undertake all administration and credit control functions for your portfolio. Provide assistance to the other administrators and cover for them when they are out of the office. Maintain accurate time sheets to reflect the work undertaken. Collaborate with, and provide technical support to the team, offering guidance and support to team members as and when required. Proactively keep up-to-date with industry legislation and proposed changes. Bring to the attention of Directors any issues of concern to ensure they are reported in a timely manner. Assist with projects. Key Skills and Experience: Minimum of 5 years' experience as a TCSP technician and ideally hold or be partly qualified in an industry recognised qualification i.e. STEP, ICSA, ACCA. Excellent working knowledge of the Isle of Man Companies Act, and related corporate governance supported by a high level working knowledge and understanding of Anti Money-Laundering and other current legislation. Self-driven, results-oriented and reliable, with a positive outlook, and a clear focus on high quality service. Mature, credible and comfortable in dealing with professional people and high net worth individuals. Well-developed inter-personal skills, with an ability to motivate other administrators and interact with senior management. Self-Motivation and disciplined in task completion with the ability to resolve issues with minimum supervision. High level or organisational and prioritisation skills; flexibility and willingness to help other in a friendly and professional manner. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16779

This individual will drive customer growth and deliver measurable commercial outcomes through the effective management and optimisation of Sure’s digital marketing channels across all island markets. The role will lead performance marketing, website optimisation, customer acquisition, conversion improvement and data driven testing to maximise return on marketing investment. The successful candidate will also build in-house digital capability, taking greater ownership of campaign delivery and analysis while leveraging external partners where specialist expertise is required.

Passionate about their people and communities, the ideal individual would hold the following skills:

Strong, hands-on performance marketing experience, including direct management and optimisation of paid digital campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta or equivalent.
Demonstrable experience managing digital marketing budgets against commercial performance measures such as CPA, CAC, conversion rate, ROAS or equivalent.
Strong analytical capability and the ability to turn digital, campaign and funnel data into prioritised actions and measurable performance improvement.
Proven experience managing and optimising website content, landing pages and digital customer journeys, with a strong understanding of conversion-rate optimisation and experimentation.
Practical experience with web analytics, conversion tracking and reporting tools such as Google Analytics, Tag Manager, Looker Studio or equivalent. 
We are proud of the “way we do things” at Sure; We work together as One Team, We strive for Customer Satisfaction, We are Reliable, We have a Passion for Technology & Learning and We are Community & Sustainability Focused, and individuals applying will “feel connected” to our Company values.

Free Ultrafast Broadband.

Generous bonus scheme.
Healthcare.

PLUMBER – HOUSING MAINTENANCE TEAM
Douglas City Council are seeking a skilled, reliable and customer focused Plumber to join our Housing & Property Department to work within a supportive team committed to delivering responsive, professional and high-quality maintenance services to our community  

Carrying out a wide range of responsive and programmed plumbing repairs and maintenance works across Council owned domestic and commercial properties you must be competent in a broad range of internal and external plumbing works with an ability to undertake minor associated construction work necessary to complete repairs.  You must also have knowledge and experience of health and safety documentation, including risk assessments and method statements and an understanding of safe manual-handling techniques with the ability to carry out manual-handling operations.

You will be an experienced plumber with a strong practical background in construction, building maintenance or domestic repairs.  You will be able to work independently and as part of a team.  You must be able organise your workload effectively, meet deadlines, work with minimal supervision and provide a professional service at all times.   

Applicants must have a City & Guilds or NVQ Level 3 qualification in a relevant trade, relevant post-qualification experience, be registered with the Department of Enterprise Register of Craftsmen and Craftswomen as well as a full, clean and valid driving licence.  Strong communication skills, including the ability to deal fairly, respectfully and confidently with tenants and customer situations is also essential.  

To apply or find out more information, please visit our Job Train portal via the Council’s website.  For an informal chat about the role please contact Liam Birchall, Assistant Housing Manager (Maintenance) lbirchall@douglas.gov.im.  Alternatively, you can contact HR on (696455). 

The closing date for the receipt of completed applications is Sunday, 13th September 2026.

Miss K J Rice, Chief Executive, City Hall, Ridgeway Street, Douglas, Isle of Man, IM99 1AD

Douglas City Council is committed to recruiting a diverse and highly talented workforce representative of our City and are committed to ensuring the recruitment and selection process is inclusive and accessible to all.  We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and aim to have a workforce that represents the City we serve.

Our client seeks a Temporary Retail Sales Consultant to join their team and deliver an efficient and professional service to customers seeking information, purchasing assistance, and after-sales support for a full range of products and services. This is a part time role for 30 hours a week and will be a temporary contract for approximately 4 months. You may be required to work selected Thursday evenings and Sunday day shifts during the Christmas trading period (1 November to 31 December). Key Responsibilities: Present an efficient and professional sales service for all customers. Always greet customers with a smile. Provide customers with honest and clear information. Clearly provide all the information a customer needs to make informed decision relating to their needs. Make sure all customers leave with a complete and working service. Demonstrate and sell products and services. Attend daily staff briefings before opening. Fully competent in the use of the computerised systems and other applications relevant to the sales process after training. Provide on-going support for all products and services available, by means of face to face, email, telephone contact, and strive to resolve all customer queries/complaints. Assist if required, in training of new members of the Retail team. Attend or partake in any training that may be required. Be aware of the commercial requirements of the company and the retail department in particular. Work to meet personal and group sales targets and process all orders within targets set by the Company. Key Skills and Experience: Previous sales experience. Appreciation of the importance of customer service. Ability to deal with difficult customers. Enthusiasm for new technology. Ability to deal with and communicate effectively with customers and staff at all levels. Knowledge of Microsoft Office. An understanding of modern retail technology would be desirable. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16756

WE’RE HIRING: PART-TIME SALES.

Mace Bathurst Street.

We’re looking for two friendly and reliable Sales Assistants to join our convenience store team.

The role includes:
Serving customers using our EPOS till system.
Restocking shelves.
General store cleaning and upkeep.

Hours and shifts:
18+ hours per week.
2–3 days per week.
Morning shift: 7:30am–3pm.
Late shift: 3pm–10pm.

Extra shifts may be available to cover holidays and absences.
We can be flexible with morning or late-shift preferences, but availability must also meet the needs of the business. If you already have a full-time job, please include your availability when applying.

Applicants must be aged 18 or over because the role involves selling alcohol and other age-restricted products. You must also hold, or be willing to complete, a Responsible Persons Course—this can be discussed at interview.

Full training will be provided to the successful candidates.

To apply, please email your CV and availability to daytoday@manx.net
If you haven’t heard from us within 14 days, please assume that your application has been unsuccessful.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the day to day management of our busy Ramsey store. This is a very hands on management role, and you will be expected to lead from the front, working alongside the team and being actively involved in the daily operation of the store, including serving customers, merchandising, maintaining store standards and supporting the team wherever required. You will also be responsible for leading and developing the store team, managing sales performance and profitability, stock control, staff recruitment and performance, rotas, customer complaints, health and safety compliance, and reporting to senior management. We are looking for an organised, motivated and confident manager with proven leadership and people management skills, strong communication skills, good attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast paced retail environment. Good IT skills, commercial awareness and a strong commitment to excellent customer service are also required. To find out more and apply, please complete an Application Form on our website at https://shop.jacstores.co.uk/pages/vacancies. Only completed application forms will be considered.

From power tools to workwear, cables to pipe fittings, we offer over 60,000 products across 900+ stores – and that’s not to mention our industry-leading digital services. Join Screwfix and be part of a team of experts who get the job done quickly, affordably, and always with a smile.

You’ll be at the core of Screwfix, making sure our customers are the heart of everything we do. You’ll take your time to really get to know them whilst delivering genuinely great service. This is a fixed-term contract opportunity up to 6 months.

Notes
Van Mossel Jacksons are looking for an experienced Brand Manager in premium sales of motor vehicles (BYD & Volvo) to join their dedicated team. Working within Jacksons you will be skilled and seasoned Brand Manager in the sales of our current brands of premium new and preowned vehicles.

**Some of the responsibilities for the Brand Manager position are, but not limited to;**

Engage in the art of following up with both loyal and potential customers, nurturing relationships to bring about further transactions. 
Strive to meet and exceed monthly targets for the sale of both new and used cars. 
Seek out and approach new clients with steadfast determination, arranging meetings to understand and address their needs.
Achieve monthly sales targets for New and Used vehicles, achieving the minimum profit targets.
Achieve monthly sales targets for additional profit centres including finance.
Return correspondence from customers and ensure all matters of paperwork are tended to with diligence.
Seize every opportunity to maximise sales whilst ensuring complete customer satisfaction.

**The Brand Manager position comes with an excellent remuneration and other benefits;**

Starting Salary & excellent bonus scheme
Guaranteed Income: A generous sum guaranteed for the first three months as you train and settle in the new role.
Company Car: A desirable chariot. 
Training and Accreditation: To make sure you are developed to reach the highest level of commission.

**Requirements:**
You must possess experience in the sales, a requirement without compromise.
Knowledge of the Kerridge/ADP DMS system a benefit.
The gift of clear communication, both by phone and in person, is essential.
A valid Driving Licence.
Highly presentable, ambitious and target driven, you will have a strong passion for car sales in order to meet and exceed agreed targets for the sale of vehicles and related products.

For more details and to apply contact recruitment@jacksons.je

Notes
At Astrea Bioseparations, we develop and manufacture chromatography solutions that support the purification of biopharmaceuticals worldwide. Our products play a vital role in the development and manufacture of therapies that improve and save lives.
As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Logistics Technician to join our Production team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and takes pride in ensuring materials, products and shipments move safely, accurately and efficiently throughout the business.
Working closely with colleagues across Production, Supply Chain and Logistics, you'll play a key role in supporting the smooth running of site activities and ensuring our products reach customers around the world on time.
What you'll be doing
As a Logistics Technician, you'll be responsible for the efficient movement, storage and dispatch of materials and products throughout our facility. Key responsibilities include: Receiving, unloading and processing incoming deliveries, Verifying goods against delivery documentation and reporting discrepancies,	Storing materials safely and accurately within designated warehouse locations, 	Supplying raw materials, consumables and equipment to production teams as required,	Maintaining stock accuracy through effective inventory control and stock counting activities,Picking, packing and preparing customer orders for shipment, Coordinating domestic and international shipments in line with company procedures,Preparing waste materials for collection and disposal in accordance with site requirements, Supporting warehouse organisation and housekeeping,Operating material handling equipment, including forklifts, where authorised, Following all Health & Safety, Quality and GMP requirements, Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across the Operations function,
What we're looking for - We're looking for someone who is organised, dependable and enjoys working collaboratively to achieve shared goals.
Essential - Previous experience in a logistics, warehouse, stores or manufacturing support role, Good attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, Strong organisational and time-management skills,	Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team, Basic IT skills and confidence using business systems, A proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Desirable - Forklift truck licence or experience operating material handling equipment, Experience working within a regulated manufacturing environment, Familiarity with inventory management or ERP systems.
To Apply, please follow this link - https://biotage-1708019070.teamtailor.com/jobs/8330828-logistics-technician-astrea

Notes
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented QC Analyst to join our Quality Control team. Reporting to the QC Manager, you will support manufacturing activities through the testing of raw materials, intermediates and finished products, as well as stability studies and environmental monitoring programmes.

This role plays a key part in ensuring products meet the highest quality standards while supporting manufacturing schedules, product release activities and customer commitments. You will also provide analytical support to Technology Transfer (TT), Research & Development (R&D) and other departments across the business.

The successful candidate will perform a variety of laboratory-based testing activities using approved procedures and analytical techniques, including chromatography, spectroscopy, microbiological testing and environmental monitoring of cleanrooms and purified water systems. You will maintain accurate GMP-compliant documentation, support equipment maintenance and calibration activities, manage laboratory reagents and consumables, and contribute to laboratory housekeeping and organisation.

In addition, you will support investigations relating to out-of-specification results, deviations, change controls and corrective actions, while working collaboratively with colleagues across Quality, Manufacturing and other functions. You will also be expected to support the development of colleagues through training, coaching and sharing technical knowledge where required.

To be successful in this role, you will have at least one year's experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or fine chemical industry and a good understanding of GMP principles, Quality Management Systems, pharmacopoeial requirements and ICH guidelines. Experience using techniques such as HPLC, GC, AKTA, TLC, UV-Visible Spectroscopy, titrations, bioburden and endotoxin testing is desirable, along with experience of environmental monitoring activities.

You will possess strong attention to detail, excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential, particularly for preparing scientific documentation and working with cross-functional teams and external laboratory partners.

The role is primarily laboratory-based, with approximately 80% of your time spent in the laboratory and 20% undertaking office-based activities. Flexibility to support occasional overtime or weekend working may be required to meet business needs.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a quality-focused organisation where you can develop your technical expertise, contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and play an important role in delivering products that meet the highest standards of quality and compliance.
Please apply via this link - https://biotage-1708019070.teamtailor.com/jobs/8333782-qc-analyst-astrea
